description.sr:
Metoda `map` prolazi kroz niz i pravi **nov** niz iste dužine: za svaki element pozove funkciju koju joj damo, a ono što funkcija vrati ide na isto mesto u novom nizu. Na primer, `[1, 2, 3].map((n) => n * 2)` daje `[2, 4, 6]`. Funkcija se piše kao strelica: `(n) => n * 2` znači „za `n` vrati `n * 2`“.

Napiši funkciju `wordLengths(words)` koja vraća dužine reči.

`words` je niz tekstova. Funkcija vraća novi niz brojeva: na svakom mestu je dužina teksta sa istog mesta u `words`.

Pravila:
- prazan tekst `''` ima dužinu `0` i ostaje u rezultatu
- prazan niz daje prazan niz
- originalni niz se ne menja

Primeri:
- `wordLengths(['cat', 'house'])` → `[3, 5]`
- `wordLengths(['a', '', 'abc'])` → `[1, 0, 3]`, jer prazan tekst nema slova, ali ipak ima svoje mesto
- `wordLengths([])` → `[]`

Ovde vežbaš `map`. Testovi proveravaju samo rezultat, pa je dozvoljena i petlja.
description.en:
The `map` method goes through an array and creates a **new** array of the same length: for every element it calls the function we give it, and what the function returns goes to the same place in the new array. For example, `[1, 2, 3].map((n) => n * 2)` gives `[2, 4, 6]`. The function is written as an arrow: `(n) => n * 2` means “for `n` return `n * 2`”.

Write a function `wordLengths(words)` that returns the lengths of words.

`words` is an array of texts. The function returns a new array of numbers: at every place is the length of the text from the same place in `words`.

Rules:
- an empty text `''` has length `0` and stays in the result
- an empty array gives an empty array
- the original array is not changed

Examples:
- `wordLengths(['cat', 'house'])` → `[3, 5]`
- `wordLengths(['a', '', 'abc'])` → `[1, 0, 3]`, because an empty text has no letters but still has its place
- `wordLengths([])` → `[]`

Here you practise `map`. Tests check only the result, so a loop is allowed too.

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function wordLengths` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(words)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: `words` je niz tekstova čije dužine tražimo. Poziv `wordLengths(['a', 'bb'])` daje `words = ['a', 'bb']`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 3.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function wordLengths` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(words)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: `words` is the array of texts whose lengths we want. The call `wordLengths(['a', 'bb'])` gives `words = ['a', 'bb']`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 3 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Cela obrada je u jednoj liniji.

- `return` vraća vrednost iz funkcije: ono što stoji desno od njega.
- `words.map(...)` poziva metodu `map` nad nizom `words`. `map` prolazi kroz elemente redom i pravi **nov** niz iste dužine. Original ostaje isti.
- `(word) => word.length` je funkcija koju dajemo metodi `map`. Levo od `=>` je parametar `word`: jedan element niza. Desno je ono što funkcija vraća: `word.length`, broj slova u tekstu. Kad iza `=>` nema `{ }`, desni izraz se vraća sam, bez reči `return`.
- Ono što funkcija vrati za neki element postaje element novog niza na istom mestu.
- Prazan tekst ima `.length` jednak `0`, pa i on daje `0`. Prazan niz daje prazan niz, jer nema nijednog elementa za obradu.

```
words = ['a', '', 'abc']
'a'   → 1
''    → 0
'abc' → 3
rezultat: [1, 0, 3]
```
text.en:
The whole processing is on one line.

- `return` returns a value from the function: what stands to the right of it.
- `words.map(...)` calls the `map` method on the array `words`. `map` goes through the elements in order and creates a **new** array of the same length. The original stays the same.
- `(word) => word.length` is the function we give to `map`. To the left of `=>` is the parameter `word`: one element of the array. To the right is what the function returns: `word.length`, the number of letters in the text. When there is no `{ }` after `=>`, the right-hand expression is returned by itself, without the word `return`.
- What the function returns for an element becomes the element of the new array at the same place.
- An empty text has `.length` equal to `0`, so it gives `0` too. An empty array gives an empty array, because there are no elements to process.

```
words = ['a', '', 'abc']
'a'   → 1
''    → 0
'abc' → 3
result: [1, 0, 3]
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Najkraće: `map` radi baš ono što zadatak traži i ne menja original.
note.en: The shortest: `map` does exactly what the task asks for and does not change the original.

text.sr:
Pravimo prazan niz u koji ćemo ubacivati dužine.

- `const` pravi promenljivu koja se ne dodeljuje ponovo. Sadržaj niza se menja, a to je dozvoljeno.
- `[]` je prazan niz.
- Ako je ulaz prazan, petlja se uopšte ne izvrši i upravo ovaj prazan niz se vraća.
text.en:
We create an empty array into which we will put the lengths.

- `const` creates a variable that is not assigned again. The contents of the array change, which is allowed.
- `[]` is an empty array.
- If the input is empty, the loop does not run at all and exactly this empty array is returned.

text.sr:
Prolazimo kroz sve elemente ulaza.

- `for (const word of words)` znači: za svaki element niza `words`, redom, uradi telo petlje.
- U svakom krugu `word` je jedan element. `const` ovde nije greška: u svakom krugu nastaje nova promenljiva `word`.
- `{` otvara telo petlje; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 5.
text.en:
We go through all elements of the input.

- `for (const word of words)` means: for every element of the array `words`, in order, run the loop body.
- In every round `word` is one element. `const` is not a mistake here: a new variable `word` is created in every round.
- `{` opens the loop body; it is closed by `}` on line 5.

text.sr:
Dodajemo dužinu tekućeg teksta na kraj niza.

- `word.length` je broj slova u tekstu `word`.
- `lengths.push(x)` dodaje `x` na kraj niza `lengths`.
- Nema provere `if`, pa se i prazan tekst obrađuje: njegova dužina `0` ulazi u rezultat.

```
krug  word    word.length  lengths posle kruga
1     'a'     1            [1]
2     ''      0            [1, 0]
3     'abc'   3            [1, 0, 3]
```
text.en:
We add the length of the current text to the end of the array.

- `word.length` is the number of letters in the text `word`.
- `lengths.push(x)` adds `x` to the end of the array `lengths`.
- There is no `if` check, so an empty text is processed too: its length `0` goes into the result.

```
round  word    word.length  lengths after the round
1      'a'     1            [1]
2      ''      0            [1, 0]
3      'abc'   3            [1, 0, 3]
```

text.en:

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr: Vraćamo napunjeni niz. Ulazni niz `words` smo samo čitali, nikad menjali.
text.en: We return the filled array. We only read the input array `words`, never changed it.
